items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Is there an accordion on one side of that Wingy Manone record? ... I think there may be on that 'My Cellar' thing.

ctx.x: Show business. And it became a -- that came with the accordion. The accordion came in and the accordion was an instrument that you could go from table to table and play. And play music.
Is there an accordion on one side of that Wingy Manone record?
I think there may be on that 'My Cellar' thing. I think he have found might not the piano player that day, or somebody sold him on the idea of using it.
